digest.component_or_area: Bridge runner orchestration and CI integration
propositions: Extract bridge orchestration into a runner-neutral packaged Python core exposing the operation through Python library (rebar.bridge_run), CLI (rebar bridge run --profile), and MCP tool interfaces.

Support five execution profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) that map to existing rebar CLI routes while preserving legacy MODE environment variable compatibility.
Ensure the wheel is installable from pip, Homebrew's wheel-backed environment, and MCP Registry/uvx, with no repository-local runner script shipped; validation must cover all three install shapes.
Translate legacy benign reconcile results (3/4/75) to canonical success for new provider runners while preserving direct legacy callers' behavior and operational error codes.

Provider wrappers (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab) invoke only the installed rebar bridge run CLI; GitHub Actions/GitLab provider schemas and embedded shell are validated against pinned ShellCheck and GitLab Draft-07 schema with immutable provenance.
